room.note: The indoor size chip. The preset is built in this closed rectangle before a door is added.

snap.top: Sits on a table, counter, or lectern top. The host is the surface under it.
snap.edge: Tucks to a table edge. Banquet chairs use this. edgeFor on the table names which edge items fit.
snap.wall: Hangs on a wall (room wall, booth wall, or pipe and drape). A TV in this mode is the panel and mount, without the floor stand.
snap.wallfloor: Stands on the floor against a room wall or a booth back wall.
snap.backwall: Stands inside a booth against its back wall.
snap.nearwall: Stands on the floor against a room wall.

place.end: Queue barricades, feeder cable, and cable ramps pull flush end to end.
place.outside: The generator sits outside the room.

presets.name: Booth
presets.note: 10 x 10 booths along the walls, a table in each
presets.recipe: 10 × 10 booths along the walls, 10.5 ft apart, with a 10 ft aisle when the room is deep enough. Each booth gets a 6 ft table. Standard and Showcase add a 55 in TV on the back wall, a laptop or tablet on the table, LED posters, charging towers on the aisle, and one LED wall at the entrance.

presets.name: Classroom
presets.note: Rows of tables facing a podium
presets.recipe: Rows of 6 ft tables facing the front, two banquet chairs on the near edge of each table. A lectern sits up front with a laptop. Standard uses a projector screen; Showcase uses an LED wall, a laptop and tablet on the tables, side TVs, speakers, and a poster wall at the entrance.

presets.name: Banquet
presets.recipe: 60 in rounds on a grid. Eight banquet chairs sit on a 3.2 ft radius around each table, with 5 ft between chair backs. A front band holds the stage tech: an LED wall, a lectern with a laptop, side TVs, corner speakers, and entrance posters. Showcase adds the extra speakers and a charging tower.

presets.name: Theater
presets.note: Rows of chairs facing a stage (36 in rows)
presets.recipe: Banquet chairs in rows 36 in apart, 18 in wide, facing the front wall, with a centre aisle. The front holds an LED wall, a lectern with a laptop, and speakers. Showcase adds projector screens beside the LED wall, side speakers, a poster wall, a kiosk, and a charging tower.

presets.name: Registration
presets.note: Check-in tables, laptops, signs and kiosks
presets.recipe: Up to four 6 ft check-in tables, two chairs behind each, laptops on the tables. Standard adds a second laptop and a 75 in TV behind the desks. Showcase uses an LED wall instead of that TV, plus monitors, LED posters, kiosks in the queue, and a charging tower.
